Package com.crosswordle.game

Class CrosswordPuzzle

java.lang.Object
com.crosswordle.game.CrosswordPuzzle
public class CrosswordPuzzle extends Object
Central game engine that orchestrates BoardGenerator, GameState and TimerManager. - Does NOT handle UI rendering; UI should listen to property changes from this engine as well as GameState (the engine forwards GameState events).

    • closeGame

      public void closeGame()
      Completely resets the entire game engine. - Stops timers - Clears guess history - Clears board contents - Resets GameState (players, scores, turn indices, gameOver flag) After this call, the engine is in a blank state and ready for startNewGame().
